title: Failed Login Detections
description: Failed database authentication grouped by target and user for alarm drilldown.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('LOGIN','LOGON') and 'Operation Status' = 'FAILURE' | stats count as 'Failed Logins' by 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Database User' | sort -'Failed Logins'
